text:
B: Hello.
A: Hiya.
B: We're wearing the same thing.
A: Ha. Navy fleece, grey T-shirt. Work uniform?
B: Not officially. It just is.
A: Same. I'm Leanne.
B: Karen. Are you off to work?
A: Lates, yeah. Warehouse. I'm a shift manager off the M62, distribution. You?
B: Admin for a haulage firm near Gatwick. Timesheets, MOTs, purchase orders. I'll probably end up dealing with drivers who've been to your sort of place.
A: Probably. Sorry about them in advance.
B: It's fine. They're all the same. You ask for one simple thing and it comes back a week late with a coffee ring on it.
A: Try agency staff. Half of them don't turn up, and the half that do don't know what a scanner is. And I've got a customer audit in three weeks, and me return-to-work forms are, erm. Let's say they're in a pile.
B: How big a pile?
A: Big enough.
B: Do one a day. Start tonight. Put them in date order and tick them off on a sheet so you can see it going down.
A: You're the second person today who's told me that.
B: Then it's probably right.
A: That's what she said an' all.
B: Well. Great minds.
A: It's not that I can't do it. I'd just rather be on the floor sorting stuff than sat in the office with a pen. D'you know what I mean.
B: I do. But the auditor doesn't care where you'd rather be.
A: No. Fair.
B: Is that a dog lead behind you?
A: Bella. Staffy. She's eaten the settee cushions this week, so she's in my bad books. Grey velvet an' all, from Dunelm.
B: That's expensive chewing.
A: Tell me about it. What are you doing for your holidays this year, anything?
B: Tenerife. Same place as last year. I know the hotel, I know the pool, I know which sunbeds get the shade.
A: I've done Tenerife. Lanzarote, Turkey twice, Majorca. I like knowing what I'm getting. Dean wants to try somewhere new and I'm like, why?
B: Exactly. Why pay to be disappointed?
A: I hate the flying, though. I have a couple of drinks at the airport, just to calm meself down.
B: I'm ten minutes from Gatwick, so I'm there and through security before I've had time to worry.
A: Lucky. I have to go to Leeds Bradford or Manchester. It's—
